mission.title: argo-workflows: Controller: `invalid config map object received in config watcher. Ignored processing` with CPU spike
mission.description: Controller: `invalid config map object received in config watcher. Ignored processing` with CPU spike. This issue affects 34+ users.

steps.title: Identify argo-workflows analyze symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your argo-workflows deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo-workflows -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-workflows
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-workflows -n argo-workflows --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review argo-workflows configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant argo-workflows configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n argo-workflows -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-workflows
kubectl get configmap -n argo-workflows -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argo-workflows
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for Controller: `invalid config map object received in config…
steps.description:
It seems this is only happening with kubernetes version 1.27 or later. Does anyone have evidence of it happening on earlier versions?

We are still using client-go from 0.24, which should not be compatible with 1.27, so perhaps that's the cause here.
```yaml
Name:         argo-workflow-controller-configmap
Namespace:    argo
Labels:       app.kubernetes.io/component=workflow-controller
              app.kubernetes.io/instance=argo
              app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm
              app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-workflows-cm
              app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argo-workflows
              helm.sh/chart=argo-workflows-0.33.1
Annotations:  meta.helm.sh/release-name: argo
              meta.helm.sh/release-namespace: argo
```

steps.title: Upgrade argo-workflows to include the fix
steps.description:
If the fix is included in a newer release, upgrade argo-workflows:
```bash
helm repo update
helm upgrade argo-workflows argo-workflows/argo-workflows --namespace argo-workflows
```
Verify the upgrade:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo-workflows
helm list -n argo-workflows
```

steps.title: Confirm Controller: `invalid config map object received… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo-workflows -n argo-workflows --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n argo-workflows --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
